title: Starting his first band in 1919
summary: He began playing in a band at 17 and lists its members, though the ASR loops on one name.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: About traditional jazz I'd like to ask you, who did you play traditional jazz with in New Orleans? With what bands? Who was playing it before you went away?

Well, I started playing in a band actually in 1919. I was 17 years old and I was going on 18. I wouldn't be 18 in November of that year, in 1919, but I started playing a little before I got to my birthday so it actually made me start playing at 17. Oh that's pretty young.
Now we formed a band ourselves.

And I don't want to make it too long but I'll tell you some of the members of the band. On drumming we had Si Frasier, Josiah Frasier on drumming. On bass we had Eddie Barrera. On piano we had Mercedes Fields. On the trumpet we had Bush Hall. Well Bush Hall died and he was replaced with Red Alam. He had Red Alam. He had Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera.
Darius Ballera. Yeah they take me to the end.
